title: UPDATED 2026-11-04 — AUDIENCE EVIDENCE FROM REDDIT (adds to the audience segmentation and use cases; nothing removed)
intro: Same 14 themes as the forum research, coded on a random sample of 500 Reddit posts (412 by caregivers). The audience boxes, labels, use cases and prioritization on this board are unchanged. This adds the Reddit numbers next to them so the owner can see where Reddit agrees or disagrees. Numbers read as main topic / mentioned anywhere. The forum counts on the board look like 'mentioned anywhere' counts (23 of 55 = 42% matches burnout's 43% anywhere share), so they are compared with Reddit's 'anywhere' share.
segments:
GEOGRAPHIC
• Long-distance caregiving: 2 (0%) / 33 (8%) of Reddit caregiver posts (forums: 1 (1%) / 8 (7%) of 117). Both sources agree it's a small share.

BEHAVIORAL
• The person refuses help (won't accept aides, moving, doctors or devices): 38 (9%) / 83 (20%). Forums: 3 (3%) / 12 (10%). Much bigger on Reddit.
• Family coordination and siblings: 17 (4%) / 97 (24%). Forums: 7 (6%) / 28 (24%). Same share mentioned.
• Hands-on personal care (incontinence, bedbound care, wound care, supplies): 17 (4%) posts as main topic. Not a forum theme.
• Tools families name (672 Reddit posts about tools, 2026-11-03): group chats and texts, paper notebooks, calendars, spreadsheets and pill boxes come up far more than any caregiving app.

DEMOGRAPHIC
• Who is cared for (Reddit sample): parent 269 (65%), other relative 68 (17%), spouse or partner 35 (8%), paid client 11 (3%), child 3 (1%), unclear 26 (6%). Forums: parent 55, spouse or partner 54 of 117. Reddit is mostly adult children caring for a parent (Audience 1). Spouse posts (Audience 2) are a small share on Reddit.

SOCIOECONOMIC
• The caregiver's own life (job, money, health): 20 (5%) / 113 (27%). Forums: 1 (1%) / 30 (26%).
• Money, insurance and legal papers: 32 (8%) / 117 (28%). Forums: 10 (9%) / 39 (33%).

a2: AUDIENCE 2 (spouse or partner): only 35 spouse posts in the Reddit sample, too few to rank use cases. Burnout is the main topic of 19 (54%) / 25 (71%).
limits: LIMITS: one reader coded each post once, and no person double-checked. Posts only, no comments. The forum counts on the board came from a different reader and method, so compare the shares, not exact numbers. Data: caregiving-coordinator docs/sources/market-analysis-3/ (count_by_audience.py, reddit-sample-by-audience.json).
